key_concepts: Evolution is slow gradual change in organisms and change in allele frequency
Natural selection favors organisms with adaptive traits
Lamarck proposed organisms change; Darwin proposed natural selection after Galapagos voyag
Genetic drift is chance change in gene pool
Gene flow is migration and interbreeding between populations
Mutation is change in chromosome structure or gene composition
Non-random mating includes inbreeding and sexual selection
Speciation begins with geographic isolation and forms new species
Direct evidence includes fossils; indirect evidence includes genetics, comparative anatomy
Homologous, analogous, and vestigial structures indicate evolutionary relationships
Gene pool is genetic composition of a population
Evolutionary patterns include convergent evolution, adaptive radiation, coevolution, punct
